model_architecture.sorting_rearrangement: Chernozhukov et al. (2010) Monotone Quantile Rearrangement

discrepancy_resolution_5_vs_9.finding: P5 is strictly a 9-quantile estimator in all model code, configuration files, and prediction parquets.
discrepancy_resolution_5_vs_9.origin_of_5_quantiles: In Phase R28, audit scripts (generate_r28_audit_artifacts_v2.py) documented a 5-quantile subset {0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90} in text notes without inspecting PRE_REGISTERED_QUANTILES.
discrepancy_resolution_5_vs_9.determination: The 5-quantile description was an underspecified documentation error in R28; the true model trained and evaluated across all phases is the 9-quantile estimator.
